newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH FIN MIN SAYS SURE TO REACH '98 BUDGET CUTS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH FIN MIN SAYS SURE TO REACH '98 BUDGET CUTS.

text.p: Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto said on Thursday he was confident that the government would be able to agree next week on additional savings needed to cut 1998 budget spending to the ministry's new 188 billion markka target.
"I am sure than we can collect the needed cuts of about 3-4 billion markka," Niinisto told Reuters Financial Television (RFTV) in an interview due to be broadcast later on Thursday.

Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen, at a news conference on Thursday, voiced strong support for the new savings plan, which is targetted to reduce the 1998 deficit to 17 billion markka from an earlier projected 21 billion.
The government is scheduled to hold on August 13-15 a final round of talks on the 1998 state budget proposal.
